resume: Family or social housing allowance: who is entitled, the documents to prepare (including the rent certificate signed by the landlord) and applying to the Caf de La Réunion (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) after a separation.
aQuoiCaSert: Housing benefits reduce the rent you pay each month. With children or family benefits, the one that applies to you is usually the ALF (allocation de logement familiale, family housing allowance); otherwise the ALS (allocation de logement sociale, social housing allowance). After a separation, each parent who takes a home can make their own application, calculated on their own income and new family situation only.
quiEstConcerne: Tenants or subtenants of decent housing occupied as their main residence.
ALF: in particular people who receive family benefits or the AEEH (disabled child education allowance), or single pregnant women from the 5th month of pregnancy, under certain conditions.
ALS: people who meet neither the conditions for the APL (aide personnalisée au logement, personalized housing aid) nor those for the ALF.
Foreign nationals must hold a valid residence permit.
aSavoir: APL, ALF and ALS cannot be combined. The amount depends on your income over the last 12 months, your rent, your family situation and where the home is: only the Caf simulator gives an estimate.
The household's assets (real estate and financial) are taken into account when they exceed €30,000.
Entitlement starts on the 1st day of the month after your file is processed, which can take about 2 months. The benefit is paid on the 5th of each month: apply as soon as you move in.
If refused, you have 2 months from the notice to challenge the decision with the Caf, then refer the matter to the amicable appeals committee (commission de recours amiable).
Separation: report it to the Caf. Each parent declares their own home and their own family situation; the amount is recalculated accordingly.
